analysis.title: Alibaba Group (BABA) 2QFY27 review: AI Cloud growth downward reset; A clearer path to FCF inflection; maintain Buy
key_insights: Alibaba's 2QFY27 revenue growth was in line at 10%. Adjusted group EBITA was +260% yoy and 6% above GSe. GS says AI Cloud & Compute outlook is better than feared despite the new restrictions on overseas rented compute.

Management cut CY2027 Cloud revenue growth guidance to 30-45% from 50%+. It expects a return to 50%+ in CY28 as T-Head capacity ramps. It maintained the CY30 US$100bn external Cloud revenue and 20% margin targets.

AI Cloud & Compute revenue accelerated to +53% yoy in 2QFY27. External customer revenue grew 64% yoy and recurring external revenue grew 67% yoy. AI-related products kept triple-digit growth at a US$10bn+ quarterly annualized run-rate. Adjusted EBITA margin rose to 14.5%.

GS reads the slower FY27E Cloud growth as supply and timing driven, not a change in AI demand. GS estimates overall cloud revenue growth of 57%/32% in the Dec 2027/Mar 2028 quarters (prior 57%/57%) and cloud margin of 15.2%/15.0%.

Capex fell qoq to Rmb50.5bn in 2QFY27 from Rmb67.7bn, partly on procurement and payment timing. FCF outflow narrowed to Rmb34.5bn. The company expects the heaviest AI infrastructure investment in CY27-CY28 and FCF to turn positive in 2H28.
The company's prior 20GW capacity target for end-2032 will come in lower given the shift to domestic compute. GS now estimates 11GW of owned plus leased IT power by end-CY2032 (prior 13GW).

T-Head's V900 chip is expected to enter production in 1Q27. Domestic proprietary compute is about 10% of Alibaba's compute today. T-Head chips will be prioritized for model training and key strategic partners, with a broader mix of domestic chips used for inference.
AI Labs & Applications revenue grew 51% yoy and adjusted EBITA loss narrowed to Rmb10.5bn from Rmb13.9bn in the prior quarter. MaaS ARR was about Rmb20bn in Sep 2026, against a Rmb30bn FY27 target.

E-commerce Group adjusted EBITA rose 243% yoy to Rmb38.9bn. CMR was -5% yoy (+1% like-for-like). Quick commerce losses are narrowing, with a target to halve losses in FY28 and reach profitability by FY29.

GS lowers FY27E-FY29E adjusted EPS by -10% to +7% on lower cloud profits, partly offset by investment discipline in AI labs and applications. It cuts the 12-month SOTP target to US$160/HK$156 from US$177/HK$172.

GS cuts its Dec-quarter CMR growth estimate to -10% (prior -5%) and FY27E to -8% (prior -5%), citing the consumption backdrop and the merchant rebate policy. It lowers the traditional eCommerce P/E multiple to 7X from 8X and the AI cloud and compute P/S multiple to 4.5X from 5X.
GS forecasts FY27E/FY28E EPS growth of +70%/+13% yoy and Dec 2026 quarter EPS growth of +118% yoy. The stock trades at 11X FY27E P/E after falling 23% over the past month and 47% year to date.

market_movers.rationale: Maintains Buy and cuts the target to $160 from $177. GS cites a path for share price recovery at 11X FY27E P/E given the better-than-feared cloud outlook and FY27E/28E EPS inflection.

earnings_insights: 2QFY27 revenue growth was 10% yoy, in line with GSe. Adjusted group EBITA was +260% yoy and 6% above GSe (reported 2QFY27, 20 Nov 2026 note).
AI Cloud & Compute revenue was +53% yoy in 2QFY27 (reported), with adjusted EBITA margin of 14.5% (reported).
2QFY27 capex was Rmb50.5bn (reported) against Rmb67.7bn the prior quarter. FCF outflow was Rmb34.5bn (reported).

GS forecasts Dec 2026 quarter EPS growth of +118% yoy (GS estimate, not yet reported). GS quarterly EPS estimates are Rmb15.48 for 12/26E and Rmb14.09 for 3/27E, after Rmb8.52 for 6/26 and Rmb8.10 for 9/26.
GS FY27E/FY28E/FY29E EPS is Rmb46.54/52.63/68.01 (new GS estimates), against Rmb43.56/55.96/75.62 previously. FY27E revenue is Rmb1,099,231mn (new GS estimate) against Rmb1,120,831mn previously.
Management guides CY2027 Cloud revenue growth of 30-45%, down from 50%+. It expects 50%+ in CY28 and targets FCF positive in 2H28.

trade_ideas.description: Long BABA / 9988.HK (Buy) with 12-month SOTP-based target price of US$160 / HK$156
trade_ideas.rationale: The cloud impact from new compute restrictions is better than feared, and FY27E/28E EPS is inflecting (+70%/+13% yoy).
trade_ideas.risk: Lower-than-expected GMV growth due to macro/competition, slower monetization in China retail, weaker execution in key strategic investments, and cloud revenue growth deceleration.

risk_factors: Lower-than-expected GMV growth due to macro or competition.
Weaker-than-expected execution in key strategic investments.
Restrictions on overseas rented compute limit near-term cloud growth.
Merchant rebate policy and the soft consumption backdrop weigh on CMR growth.
geopolitical: The report refers to recently stricter restrictions on overseas rented compute, which caused significant volatility in Alibaba's share price over the past week. It describes this as constraining Alibaba's overseas compute access.
